purpose: Content that would make BroadbandPicker eligible for nine regional full-fibre altnet Awin programmes. Per altnet: a provider review, a head-to-head against the local incumbent, and a local best-broadband guide, plus shared altnet explainers and a roundup. Build the provider review and roundup first, get them indexed, then apply with those pages as the relevance proof.
scoring_note: opportunity_score is a 0-100 composite of editorial 1-5 bands plus 1-3 bands, commercial_value weighted higher than the adjacency plan because these are direct ISP affiliate programmes. No fabricated search volume, CPC or keyword-difficulty numbers.
